t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The colours of the gnomes are what matters and you should remember which colour leads to the most mushrooms. The size and position of the gnomes does not matter. But they do take you to different forests, some with better amounts of mushrooms than others.

vb_textbox.text: Despite previous advice, I could not see that there was a direct correlation between which colour gnome you chose. It may be worth trying the left hand gnome several times in a row, followed by the right, during the trial. I was told that the colour of gnome denoted a greater sum of mushrooms but I do not believe this to be true.
